yogas.name: Raja Yoga (Lord of 1 + 5)
yogas.description: The lords of the 1st and 5th houses are conjunct or in mutual aspect, forming a powerful Raja Yoga that bestows intelligence, authority, and success.
statements: A powerful Raja Yoga is present in your chart, linking your personality with intelligence and creativity.
You are blessed with leadership, recognition, and remarkable mental capabilities.
Success in government, academia, or creative fields is strongly indicated.

yogas.name: Raja Yoga (Lord of 1 + 9)
yogas.description: The lords of the 1st and 9th houses are conjunct or in mutual aspect, a highly auspicious Raja Yoga for fortune and dharma.
statements: An outstanding Raja Yoga links your personality with supreme fortune.
Your life is guided by a powerful dharmic purpose and philosophical wisdom.
Success, fame, and good fortune will manifest strongly after your 30s.

yogas.name: Raja Yoga (Lord of 4 + 5)
yogas.description: Lords of the 4th and 5th houses combined, creating a Raja Yoga for property, happiness, children, and intelligence.
statements: A powerful Raja Yoga blesses you with property, domestic happiness, and brilliant intelligence.
Your home life is a foundation for professional and creative success.
Strong real estate gains and fortunate children are indicated.

yogas.name: Raja Yoga (Lord of 9 + 10)
yogas.description: The most powerful Raja Yoga: the lords of Fortune (9th) and Career (10th) are connected. This is called Dharma-Karmadhipati Yoga.
statements: The supreme Dharma-Karmadhipati Raja Yoga blesses your chart with extraordinary career success.
Your profession is aligned with your dharma, creating a path of meaningful achievement.
Public recognition, high status, and lasting fame are strongly indicated in your Dasha periods.

yogas.name: Gaja Kesari Yoga
yogas.description: Jupiter and Moon are in mutual Kendra (1, 4, 7, 10 from each other), creating the Elephant-Lion Yoga of brilliance, fame, and wisdom.
statements: Gaja Kesari Yoga — the Elephant and Lion — graces your chart with brilliance, fame, and moral authority.
You possess the intellectual strength of an elephant and the courage of a lion.
Recognition, wisdom, and public respect will grow throughout your life.

yogas.name: Ruchaka Yoga (Mars)
yogas.description: Mars is in its own sign (Aries/Scorpio) or exaltation (Capricorn) in a Kendra house (1,4,7,10), forming Ruchaka Yoga of the Pancha Mahapurusha.
statements: The legendary Ruchaka Yoga is present in your chart, marking you as a person of extraordinary courage, strength, and leadership.
You have the aura of a warrior and commander; enemies will bow before you.
Success in military, law enforcement, sports, or any field requiring decisive action is destined.

yogas.name: Bhadra Yoga (Mercury)
yogas.description: Mercury is in its own sign (Gemini/Virgo) or exaltation (Virgo) in a Kendra house (1,4,7,10), forming Bhadra Yoga.
statements: The Bhadra Yoga, one of the five great yogas, is present, blessing you with exceptional intellectual brilliance.
You are a gifted communicator, analyst, and thinker whose words carry great weight.
Success in writing, finance, science, or any communication-intensive field is your destiny.

yogas.name: Hamsa Yoga (Jupiter)
yogas.description: Jupiter is in its own sign (Sagittarius/Pisces) or exaltation (Cancer) in a Kendra house (1,4,7,10), forming Hamsa Yoga.
statements: The divine Hamsa Yoga graces your chart, marking you as a person of profound wisdom, grace, and moral authority.
You are a natural teacher, guide, and philosopher whose life is touched by divine grace.
Wealth, knowledge, and spiritual fulfillment will be your life's rewards.

yogas.name: Malavya Yoga (Venus)
yogas.description: Venus is in its own sign (Taurus/Libra) or exaltation (Pisces) in a Kendra house (1,4,7,10), forming Malavya Yoga.
statements: The beautiful Malavya Yoga marks you as a person of extraordinary grace, artistic talent, and romantic magnetism.
Luxury, beauty, and the finest pleasures of life will surround you.
Exceptional success in arts, entertainment, fashion, or finance is strongly indicated.

yogas.name: Sasa Yoga (Saturn)
yogas.description: Saturn is in its own sign (Capricorn/Aquarius) or exaltation (Libra) in a Kendra house (1,4,7,10), forming Sasa Yoga.
statements: The powerful Sasa Yoga blesses your chart with the discipline, perseverance, and authority of Saturn at its peak.
You are destined to rise from humble beginnings to a position of great power and respect.
Leadership over the masses, political authority, or mastery of a technical field is your destiny.

yogas.name: Adhi Yoga
yogas.description: Mercury, Venus, and Jupiter are in the 6th, 7th, and 8th houses from the Moon, forming Adhi Yoga of leadership and wealth.
statements: Adhi Yoga — the Yoga of the Chief — is present, indicating great leadership qualities and capacity to rise above enemies.
You have the natural ability to command, organize, and lead groups of people.
Political success, executive power, or community leadership is strongly indicated.

yogas.name: Chandra Mangala Yoga
yogas.description: Moon and Mars are conjunct, forming Chandra Mangala Yoga, indicating wealth through business, real estate, and courageous action.
statements: Chandra Mangala Yoga is present, combining emotional intelligence with courageous drive.
Significant wealth through business, real estate, or entrepreneurship is strongly indicated.
You have the emotional courage to take calculated risks and profit from them.

yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga
yogas.description: A debilitated planet is cancelled by a specific condition, turning weakness into extraordinary strength.
statements: A Neecha Bhanga (cancellation of debilitation) is present in your chart, turning a potential weakness into extraordinary strength.
What appeared to be a flaw in your chart becomes one of your greatest tools for success.
This yoga is a hallmark of self-made individuals who overcome adversity to achieve greatness.

yogas.name: Kemadruma Yoga (Challenging)
yogas.description: The Moon has no planets in the 2nd or 12th house from it, creating Kemadruma Yoga indicating hardships and isolation.
statements: Kemadruma Yoga creates a tendency toward emotional isolation and periods of hardship.
You may often feel you must rely solely on your own resources and inner strength.
This challenging pattern can be mitigated by strong Jupiter placement or association with benefics.
